title: kith-events: LEI replay uses single counter for all 3 types; misses replays
description: On SSE reconnect, client sends Last-Event-ID (e.g. 's-5'). Handler compares this single counter against each type's individual current_state. State counters are per-type and often identical after a quiet period (e.g. both Chat and Message at s-5). When a type's counter equals the LEI, replay is suppressed even though the client may have missed events for that type. The code comment calls this 'safe over-silence in the accidental-equality edge case' but equal counters is the normal quiet state, not an edge case. Client gets no replay and no signal that resync is needed — silent missed-event window on reconnect.
